idle.fist: standing in a ready fighting stance, knees slightly bent, fists raised in front of the chest
idle.blade: standing in a ready fighting stance, knees slightly bent, holding WEAPON with both hands pointing forward and up
idle.sand: standing calmly with arms crossed over the chest, feet apart

walk.fist: walking forward mid-stride, one leg stepping forward, fists up in guard
walk.blade: walking forward mid-stride, one leg stepping forward, WEAPON held ready in front
walk.sand: walking forward mid-stride slowly, arms crossed

run.fist: sprinting forward at full speed, torso leaning far forward, both arms trailing straight back behind the body, one leg kicked up behind
run.blade: dashing forward at full speed, torso leaning far forward, WEAPON held low and trailing behind
run.sand: gliding forward fast, leaning forward, cloak flowing back

jump.fist: in mid-air jumping high, both knees pulled up toward the chest, arms up, feet off the ground
jump.blade: in mid-air jumping high, knees pulled up, WEAPON held close, feet off the ground
jump.sand: in mid-air jumping, knees bent up, arms slightly spread, feet off the ground

fall.fist: falling down through the air, legs extended below, arms spread out for balance, feet off the ground
fall.blade: falling down through the air, legs extended below, WEAPON held to the side, feet off the ground
fall.sand: descending through the air, legs extended below, cloak flaring up, feet off the ground

crouch.fist: crouching low on one knee after landing, one hand touching the ground
crouch.blade: crouching low on one knee after landing, WEAPON held down at the side
crouch.sand: crouching low on one knee, one hand on the ground

guard.fist: blocking defensively, both forearms crossed in front of the face, knees bent
guard.blade: blocking defensively, WEAPON held vertically in front of the body with both hands
guard.sand: protecting himself, one arm raised in front of the face, a thin wall of sand rising in front of him

hit.fist: recoiling backward from a hit to the face, head snapped back, body bent backward, eyes shut in pain
hit.blade: recoiling backward from a hit, head snapped back, body bent backward, eyes shut in pain, WEAPON still in hand
hit.sand: recoiling backward from a hit, head snapped back, body bent backward, eyes shut in pain

knock.fist: flying backward through the air after being struck, whole body horizontal and arched, arms and legs flung out, head thrown back
knock.blade: flying backward through the air after being struck, whole body horizontal and arched, limbs flung out, WEAPON still in one hand
knock.sand: flying backward through the air after being struck, whole body horizontal and arched, limbs flung out

down.fist: lying knocked out flat on his back on the ground, body horizontal, head to the LEFT and feet to the RIGHT, eyes closed
down.blade: lying knocked out flat on his back on the ground, body horizontal, head to the LEFT and feet to the RIGHT, eyes closed, WEAPON lying beside him
down.sand: lying knocked out flat on his back on the ground, body horizontal, head to the LEFT and feet to the RIGHT, eyes closed

attack1.fist: throwing a powerful straight punch forward, punching arm fully extended straight ahead, lunging stance
attack1.blade: mid horizontal slash, WEAPON swept fully forward at chest height, arms extended, lunging stance
attack1.sand: thrusting one open hand straight forward, a stream of sand shooting forward from the hand

attack2.fist: high roundhouse kick, kicking leg raised and extended forward at head height
attack2.blade: end of a powerful diagonal downward slash, WEAPON swung down in front, body leaning forward
attack2.sand: sweeping one arm forward from the side, a wave of sand following the arm

launch.fist: rising uppercut, jumping slightly, one fist thrust straight up high above the head
launch.blade: rising upward slash, WEAPON swung up high above the head, body stretching upward
launch.sand: raising both hands upward, a pillar of sand erupting upward in front of him

sweep.fist: crouched very low on one bent leg, the other leg stretched straight out forward sweeping along the floor, one hand on the ground
sweep.blade: crouched very low, slashing WEAPON horizontally just above the floor in front
sweep.sand: crouched low with one palm pressed to the ground, sand spreading forward along the floor

airatk.fist: mid-air flying kick, body diagonal, one leg fully extended forward and downward, other leg tucked, feet off the ground
airatk.blade: mid-air diving slash, body diagonal, WEAPON swung forward and down, feet off the ground
airatk.sand: in mid-air thrusting both hands downward, sand pouring down, feet off the ground

cast.fist: performing a ninja hand sign with both hands together in front of the chest, focused expression
cast.blade: pointing two fingers of one hand forward to cast a spell, WEAPON held in the other hand
cast.sand: holding one hand forward with fingers spread, controlling sand

charge.fist: powering up, fists clenched at the sides, legs braced wide, shouting, hair blown upward
charge.blade: powering up, holding WEAPON raised high overhead with both hands, legs braced, shouting
charge.sand: powering up, both arms spread wide, legs braced, cloak blown upward, intense glare

lunge.fist: lunging far forward in a deep low stance, one palm thrust as far forward as possible at chest height
lunge.blade: lunging far forward in a deep low stance with a long straight forward thrust of WEAPON
lunge.sand: lunging forward in a low stance, one hand thrust forward clenched into a fist

victory.fist: confident victory pose, one fist raised high, grinning
victory.blade: confident victory pose, resting WEAPON on the shoulder
victory.sand: calm victory pose, arms crossed, eyes closed
